public_rationale: The records document substantial progress on competition mathematics and specific limits. They do not establish the stronger comparison with professional research mathematicians. Competition performance, human assistance and restricted mathematical languages are relevant, but they do not by themselves measure 'nowhere close.' The absence of a reported research solution would also be insufficient. The full compound claim remains unresolved; there is no demonstrated contradiction warranting a mixed result.
limitations: The professional-research comparison has an ordinary meaning but no supplied threshold.
The AlphaProof source is retrospective and its dated demonstration falls outside the selected observation period.
Later research systems cannot be substituted for the versions Marcus discussed.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: These DeepMind math systems are nowhere close to professional human mathematicians, though they are well beyond what AI could previously do.

statement.excerpt: None of this puts these systems anywhere close to the level of professional human mathematicians (research problems in mathematics are mostly incomparably more difficult) but it still is well beyond what was previously possible for AI systems.
statement.document_title: AlphaGeometry2: Impressive accomplishment, but still a long path ahead

our_interpretation: The targets are AlphaGeometry2 and AlphaProof as discussed in February 2025, not later systems or AI mathematics generally.
The ordinary reading concerns the breadth and independence needed for professional mathematical research, alongside a substantial advance over earlier AI on comparable mathematical tasks.
The post supplies no reporting period. I use February 1–17, 2025 for the ongoing capability assessment, ending on the publication date. Earlier demonstrations provide context.
A single research-level solution would not establish broad professional parity. Conversely, finding no published research solution would not establish inability.
The progress comparison does not require these systems to be the first AI ever to make a mathematical discovery.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence about the versions discussed establishes a substantial gap from professional research capability, while comparable evaluations establish substantial progress over earlier AI systems.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes broadly comparable professional research capability for the versions discussed, or comparable evaluations refute the claimed substantial advance over earlier systems.
